title: yencoding/decode.rs: finish_decode missing doc comment
description:
Why this exists: yencoding/src/decode.rs contains a private function finish_decode with #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] and no doc comment. The Rust coding standard mandates doc comments on everything rustdoc knows how to document, including module-private items. Functions with many parameters — especially those suppressing a clippy lint — particularly need documentation explaining what each argument does.

What goes wrong: a developer reading the code must read the entire function body to understand what each of the arguments is for. The #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] further signals that the function has a complexity that warrants explanation. Without a doc comment, the function's contract (what it expects, what it returns, what side effects it has) must be inferred from context.

Location: yencoding/src/decode.rs, fn finish_decode.

Fix: add a doc comment explaining the function's purpose and each parameter. Consider also restructuring into a config struct to address the too_many_arguments lint rather than suppressing it.
close_reason: P2 polish: finish_decode is a private function. Internal doc comments are nice-to-have.
